Collaborations

UK National Health Services

We work closely with National Health Service (NHS) across the UK to use our health informatics tools for improving services and clinical research, including South London and Maudsley NHS Trust, King’s College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust, University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, NHS Lothian, NHS Education for Scotland, and eDRIS of Public Health Scotland.
